plugins.name: scott-skills
plugins.description: Scott's end-to-end workflow for Claude Code: chart an effort as a wayfinder map, resolve it, slice the decisions into shippable specs, review each slice and its spec, break it into tickets, and ship it wave by wave — driven by /next — or grow a feature a slice at a time with /iterate, decisions made just in time against an effort log in the repo — every review gate on the finding-pipeline contract, every spawned agent on a policy-resolved model tier, every test run scoped to the change by the repo's TESTING.md — plus standalone skills for grilling, design, domain modeling, prototyping, research, TDD, wizards, writing for agents, cold-reading the docs agents have worn, and a /snag → /autopsy loop that traces friction in past sessions back to the skill text that caused it.
